title: Component Timeline
summary: Official Derivative reference for the Component Timeline UI shown for networks with Component Time, covering timecode/playhead display, Run Independently behavior, Scope behavior, and root-time scope indication.
guidance: Use this article when explaining or validating how local Component Time is controlled from the network editor timeline gadget.
Run Independently lets a Component Time keep its own play state instead of following parent timelines.
Scope loads the component time into TouchDesigner's main Timeline and changes the Timeline UI color away from root time.
Do not model Component Timeline as an operator; it is UI for a network with Component Time.
